build_transcription_adapter: build a TranscriptionAdapter subclass to add support for a new ASR model
register_transcription_adapter: register a TranscriptionAdapter subclass with a model key using the decorator
resolve_adapter: resolve the correct TranscriptionAdapter for a model by matching its architecture names
build_sampling_params: build sampling_params dict from a TranscriptionRequest for GenerateReqInput
build_verbose_response: build a TranscriptionVerboseResponse with segments and timestamps from transcription results
